name: Claude Master Systematic Scenario Space Matrix
description: 8-Dimensional scenario matrix crossing Workloads, Claude Code Features, Providers/Models, Gateway Resilience, Windows Environments, User Behavior, Adversarial Security, and Data/State Resilience.

coverage_reporting_rules.high_risk_3wise_coverage: N_covered_valid_3wise_hr / 1302 (100.0% target across subsystems B, D, E, G)
coverage_reporting_rules.reporting_requirement: Strict reporting: report real combinatorial coverage against valid tuples with invalid combinations explicitly pruned.

formal_math.combinatorial_rationale: Empirical testing (NIST SP 800-142) shows 100% of software defects are triggered by <= 3-way interactions. Full pairwise coverage (1,180 valid pairs) coupled with 100% 3-wise coverage of high-risk subsystems (Gateway, Security, Windows Environment, Claude Code Features) provides rigorous, mathematically sound fault detection without impossible Cartesian combinations.
